answer: The walnut schedule is applied in thread and mesa shows each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4577 identities would post 2589 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
